headings.strategy: Blocky, arcade style, pixel-art compatible, uppercase, tight tracking

body.strategy: Pixelated monospaced, technical, high readability for stats

spacing.strategy: Dense arcade HUD spacing, generous menu spacing. Use Tailwind scales.

buttons.style: Large orange beveled buttons, pixel-art aesthetic. Heavy borders.
buttons.classes: bg-[#ff7a18] text-black border-b-[4px] border-r-[4px] border-[#9a3412] border-t-[4px] border-l-[4px] border-[#ffa872] active:border-b-0 active:border-r-0 active:border-t-[4px] active:border-l-[4px] active:translate-y-1 active:translate-x-1 rounded-none uppercase font-bold px-6 py-3 font-['VT323'] text-3xl transition-transform

panels.style: Rusted metal wall background, bullet-hole details. Use dark grimy colors with inset shadow.
panels.classes: bg-[#18181b] border-4 border-[#3f3f46] shadow-[inset_0_0_30px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] relative overflow-hidden

bars.hp: Green segmented bar with skull icon. Flex container with small gaps.
bars.hp_classes: flex gap-1 h-6 bg-[#09090b] p-1 border-2 border-[#18181b]
bars.ammo_classes: flex gap-1 h-4 bg-[#09090b] p-1 border-2 border-[#18181b]

badges.style: Small biohazard-colored or dark metal badges for stats like Dash CD, GAMBLE multiplier.
badges.classes: bg-[#09090b] border-2 border-[#ff7a18] text-[#ff7a18] px-2 py-1 font-['VT323'] text-xl

canvas.rendering: 2D Canvas context. No anti-aliasing (ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false) to preserve pixel art. Sprites drawn via ctx.drawImage().

hero_sprite.description: Top-down view of a post-apocalyptic survivor, pixel art style. Drawn facing UP (0 degrees). Must be rotated by the engine to match facing angle.

enemy_shambler.description: Top-down view of a weak mutant zombie (shambler), pixel art style. Drawn facing RIGHT. Must be mirrored horizontally by the engine to face travel direction.

enemy_brute.description: Top-down view of a large heavy mutant zombie (brute), pixel art style. Drawn facing RIGHT. Must be mirrored horizontally by the engine to face travel direction.

background_texture.description: Seamless top-down background texture of a rusted, gritty, decaying industrial metal floor.

prompts_for_main_agent.hero: Top-down view of a post-apocalyptic survivor, pixel art style, wearing a grimy industrial jumpsuit and a backpack, holding a generic two-handed weapon. The character must be facing exactly UP (0 degrees). Clear silhouette, no background (transparent or solid green for chroma key). Muted rust and olive colors.
prompts_for_main_agent.shambler: Top-down view of a weak mutant zombie (shambler), pixel art style, decaying flesh, tattered rags. Facing exactly RIGHT. Grotesque biohazard green and brown tones. Clear silhouette, solid background for easy removal.
prompts_for_main_agent.brute: Top-down view of a large heavy mutant zombie (brute), pixel art style, bulky and muscular, mutated armor-like skin, rusted metal embedded in flesh. Facing exactly RIGHT. Dark grimy colors. Clear silhouette, solid background.
prompts_for_main_agent.arena_floor: A seamless top-down background texture of a rusted, gritty, decaying industrial metal floor. Bullet holes, dark grime, blue-green oxidation, and scratched iron plates. No specific focal point, repeatable pattern style. Dark and moody lighting.

accessibility.contrast: High contrast between text and dark metal backgrounds. Use bright orange and white text.
accessibility.motion: Ensure canvas runs at 60fps, minimal unnecessary UI animations to keep focus on gameplay.

testing.data_test_ids: Mandatory for all buttons, tabs, input fields in the React UI (e.g. data-testid='start-run-button', data-testid='upgrade-card').

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Load Google Fonts 'Press Start 2P' and 'VT323' in the index.html or via @import in CSS to achieve the arcade pixel art look.
Implement the React UI (Title, Upgrades, Modal, Summary) as overlays on top of the Canvas. Do not change gameplay logic.
Apply the exact 'buttons.classes' defined for all clickable elements to match the arcade-industrial UI mockup.
Use 'VT323' font for all HUD stats, and 'Press Start 2P' for the LAST SCRAP title and major headings.
For the Canvas, load the AI-generated sprites provided in image_urls, along with 'rig_new.jpeg'.
Rotate the hero sprite in the canvas drawing logic so that it matches the facing angle (assuming base sprite points UP).
Mirror the enemy sprites horizontally based on their velocity x-component (assuming base sprite points RIGHT).
Set context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false when drawing sprites to the canvas to keep pixel art crisp.
Ensure the HUD elements (HP bars, ammo, icons) are rendered in React over the canvas using absolute positioning and Tailwind classes.
Do not use generic 'Shadcn' components for the game UI menus, build them with standard HTML/Tailwind according to the design guidelines to maintain the gritty custom arcade look.
